typography.font-sans: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, Arial

spacing.scale: 0.25rem base, generous section spacing (space-y-16 on marketing page)

shadows.style: soft, low-opacity (shadow-xs/shadow-sm), no heavy drop shadows

motion.style: subtle transitions (150-300ms), hover color/border changes, no scale-shift on hover for interactive rows

design.density: comfortable, generous whitespace, SaaS dashboard density in-app / airy on marketing page

preferredPrimitives: cn() from lib/utils for class merging
patterns: Footer currently lives at frontend/src/components/layout/Footer.tsx, rendered only on the marketing home route via AppFrame.tsx (app pages use a sidebar shell instead)
4-column footer: Brand+description+trust badge / Platform links / AI Career Suite links / Architecture stack list, then a bottom bar with copyright, social icons, and a tagline pill

must: Light theme by default, must remain legible/on-brand in dark mode via .dark class overrides
Use only lucide-react icons (no emoji, no literal robot/AI-system icons like Bot)
Keep the warm coffee-brown brand palette (#644a40 primary) - no neon/cyan colors
Footer is marketing-page-only (rendered inside AppFrame's marketing branch), not shown on in-app dashboard routes
Restrained, premium SaaS feel - avoid generic 'AI hype' styling (gradient blobs, sparkle spam, corny taglines)
avoid: Emoji as UI icons or in copy
Heavy/garish drop shadows or busy multi-stop gradients
